# LFM2-VL：单图 64 到 256 token，超过 2 倍上限就切 512 块加缩略图
lfm2 256x256 -1 1 64 thumb=64
lfm2 512x512 -1 1 256 thumb=256
lfm2 640x488 -1 1 234 thumb=234
lfm2 1024x768 -1 7 1770 thumb=234
lfm2 1536x1536 -1 10 2560 thumb=256
lfm2 2048x1024 -1 9 2290 thumb=242
lfm2 4000x3000 -1 7 1770 thumb=234
lfm2 256x256 64 1 64 thumb=64
lfm2 512x512 64 5 1088 thumb=64
lfm2 640x488 64 7 1590 thumb=54
lfm2 1024x768 64 7 1590 thumb=54
lfm2 1536x1536 64 10 2368 thumb=64
lfm2 2048x1024 64 9 2103 thumb=55
lfm2 4000x3000 64 7 1590 thumb=54
lfm2 256x256 128 1 64 thumb=64
lfm2 512x512 128 1 121 thumb=121
lfm2 640x488 128 7 1644 thumb=108
lfm2 1024x768 128 7 1653 thumb=117
lfm2 1536x1536 128 10 2425 thumb=121
lfm2 2048x1024 128 9 2176 thumb=128
lfm2 4000x3000 128 7 1653 thumb=117
